description: Pass-rate thresholds per area used by kitrun.py (RATE = PASS / (TOTAL - UNRULED); SKIP counts as not passed). 'shipped' applies to the vectors in the pack, 'holdout' to the maintainer-held 20 % sample, 'core' to vectors tagged core (always shipped). Thresholds apply to both run profiles; under --profile corrected, vectors with ruling 'proposed' are UNRULED and never count. Component ids refer to acceptance-and-grading.md.

kit_gates.description: validate-vectors.py --gate: evidence mix the kit itself must reach before release.

kit_budget.description: validate-vectors.py BUDGET caps in bytes (whole-kit runs). billing_unit = billing-engine-spec/vectors/*.jsonl plus holdout files not named ep.*; scenarios = billing-engine-spec/scenarios/*; ep_conformance = events-processor-spec/conformance/**; ep_units = events-processor-spec/vectors/*.jsonl plus holdout ep.*.jsonl; schemas_meta = reimplementation-kit/schemas/**/*.json + acceptance/* + scenarios/MANIFEST.md; total = their sum plus reimplementation-kit/kit.json (the sha256 manifest counts only here). One scenario: target and max in compact JSON, with a few exceptions up to the exception max.
